meta.title: Healthfull: medical center management system
meta.description: A bilingual system for clinics in Sudan. It runs on your own network without internet, and no service is performed before payment is settled.

hero.title: Run your medical center from registration to shift close
hero.lead: Built for Sudanese clinics. Runs on your own network, no internet needed. No service is done before payment is settled.
hero.imageAlt: Manager dashboard: confirmed collections today, and what needs attention as decision rows

problem.title: What a busy clinic day looks like
problem.lead: On paper, small mistakes creep in.
problem.p1: A drug is dispensed and never paid for.
problem.p2: An approved invoice is edited and nobody knows who.
problem.p3: A shift closes, then its numbers change.
problem.p4: Stock goes missing and nobody knows where.
problem.close: Healthfull prevents this with fixed rules.

cycle.title: One cycle, from registration to reports

doctor.title: Doctor

lab.title: Laboratory

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy

nursing.title: Nursing and procedures
nursing.text: One «Done» button records who did it and when.

claims.title: Insurance claims

reports.title: Reports

portal.title: Patient portal

safety.title: Seven rules the system enforces
safety.lead: The system's own rules, not extras.

r1.title: No service before it is settled
r1.text: Nothing is performed until paid, unless a documented authorization names who allowed it.

r2.title: An approved invoice never changes
r2.text: Corrections are credit notes linked to the original.

r3.title: A closed shift never changes
r3.text: Later effects post to the current shift, linked to the original.

r4.title: Every exception has a reason and a name
r4.text: Cancellations, discounts, refunds and transfer confirmations record reason, approver and time.

r5.title: Stock is deducted at dispensing
r5.text: Not at invoicing. Never below zero.

r6.title: The price freezes at approval
r6.text: Taken from the price list in force that day.

r7.title: The insurer share is a receivable, not cash
r7.text: Owed until the payer's payment is recorded.

safety.foot: Enforced in the server and database. Each rule has automated tests.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.a1: No fixed price is shown here. Ask for an offer that fits your center.
faq.a2: No. It runs on the center's own network. Cloud backup is optional.
faq.q3: Where is my data kept, and who sees it?
faq.a3: On a server inside your center. Each role gets only its permissions, and every change is recorded by name.
faq.a4: Yes. Arabic first, right to left, English one tap away.
faq.a5: A demo with sample data is available on request.
faq.a6: About two hours for the server, per the install guide. Data and training come after.
